# Motion for React DSH reference package

Language: Simplified Chinese.

Registers the `motion-react-review` reference Skill. It grants no tools and includes no upstream code, documentation, data, examples, or assets. See the project’s [.docs/zh-CN/guide/setup.md](https://github.com/tonulls/dsh-plugins/blob/tonulls/dsh-%5Bname%5D-tonulls/dsh-motion-react-tonulls/.docs/zh-CN/guide/setup.md) for installation and use; read the [lifecycle guide](https://github.com/tonulls/dsh-plugins/blob/tonulls/dsh-%5Bname%5D-tonulls/dsh-motion-react-tonulls/.docs/zh-CN/guide/lifecycle.md) for startup, verification, update/restart, disable/stop limits, and removal. See [UPSTREAM.json](UPSTREAM.json) for source evidence.

## 自动选择

自动选择默认在每个 Agent 中关闭。使用 `/dsh-motion-react-tonulls on` 和 `/dsh-motion-react-tonulls off` 控制；仍可直接调用 Skill。
